stale_inputs.title: Model-input staleness at the 2026-11-15 slate
stale_inputs.question: The published team ratings were cut from the official pages before the 11/15 tips. Which of those rows have already changed because the team played on 11/15?
stale_inputs.consequence: Every one of the 34 published 11/15..11/18 games is modelled from these rows. The games whose model inputs already moved are listed above; the site must say so on every affected row rather than presenting the line as current.
